description_target.target_text: Expand colored singleton spines into prioritized diagonal rays and domino wedges

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; A SPINE of single colored cells (all in one column, else one row)
 ;; plus 2-cell dominoes, one color each. On a blank canvas each domino
 ;; paints a triangular wedge that grows from the spine toward it; then
 ;; each spine cell shoots diagonal rays (4-way inside the domino span,
 ;; 2-way spine-ward beyond it), farthest spine cell painted first.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (shape-of color)
       ;; single -> (s r c color) ; domino -> (h color row cmin cmax)
       ;; or (v color rmin rmax c) ; anything else -> #f
       (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
         (cond ((= (length cells) 1)
                (list 's (first (first cells)) (second (first cells)) color))
               ((= (length cells) 2)
                (let ((r1 (first (first cells))) (c1 (second (first cells)))
                      (r2 (first (second cells))) (c2 (second (second cells))))
                  (cond ((and (= r1 r2) (= (abs (- c1 c2)) 1))
                         (list 'h color r1 (min c1 c2) (max c1 c2)))
                        ((and (= c1 c2) (= (abs (- r1 r2)) 1))
                         (list 'v color (min r1 r2) (max r1 r2) c1))
                        (else #f))))
               (else #f))))
     (define records
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map shape-of (sort (filter (lambda (v) (> v 0))
                                           (grid-colors g))
                                   <))))
     (define singles  ;; (r c color), ascending color
       (map rest (filter (lambda (rec) (eq? (first rec) 's)) records)))
     (define dominoes
       (filter (lambda (rec) (not (eq? (first rec) 's))) records))
     (define spine-vertical?
       (= (length (unique (map second singles))) 1))
     (define spine-row (first (first singles)))
     (define spine-col (second (first singles)))
     (define rmin (min-of first singles))
     (define rmax (max-of first singles))
     (define cmin (min-of second singles))
     (define cmax (max-of second singles))
     (define (dot out r c color)
       (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell out r c color) out))
     (define (wedge-h out d)  ;; horizontal domino above/below the spine
       (let ((color (second d)) (rr (third d)) (c1 (fourth d)))
         (cond
           (spine-vertical?
            (cond ((< rr rmin)
                   (for*/fold ((acc out))
                              ((r (range rr rmin))
                               (c (let ((k (- (- rmin 1) r)))
                                    (range (- spine-col k)
                                           (+ spine-col k 1)))))
                     (dot acc r c color)))
                  ((> rr rmax)
                   (for*/fold ((acc out))
                              ((r (range (+ rmax 1) (+ rr 1)))
                               (c (let ((k (- r (+ rmax 1))))
                                    (range (- spine-col k)
                                           (+ spine-col k 1)))))
                     (dot acc r c color)))
                  (else out)))
           ((< rr spine-row)
            (for*/fold ((acc out))
                       ((r (range rr spine-row))
                        (c (let ((k (- (- spine-row 1) r)))
                             (range (- c1 k) (+ c1 k 1)))))
              (dot acc r c color)))
           ((> rr spine-row)
            (for*/fold ((acc out))
                       ((r (range (+ spine-row 1) (+ rr 1)))
                        (c (let ((k (- r (+ spine-row 1))))
                             (range (- c1 k) (+ c1 k 1)))))
              (dot acc r c color)))
           (else out))))
     (define (wedge-v out d)  ;; vertical domino beside the spine
       (let ((color (second d)) (r1 (third d)) (r2 (fourth d))
             (cc (list-ref d 4)))
         (cond
           (spine-vertical?
            (cond ((> cc spine-col)
                   (let ((inner (+ spine-col 2)))
                     (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                ((c (range inner (+ cc 1)))
                                 (r (let ((k (- c inner)))
                                      (range (- r1 k) (+ r2 k 1)))))
                       (dot acc r c color))))
                  ((< cc spine-col)
                   (let ((inner (- spine-col 2)))
                     (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                ((c (range cc (+ inner 1)))
                                 (r (let ((k (- inner c)))
                                      (range (- r1 k) (+ r2 k 1)))))
                       (dot acc r c color))))
                  (else out)))
           ((< cc cmin)
            (let ((inner (+ cc 2)))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((c (range cc (+ inner 1)))
                          (r (let ((k (- inner c)))
                               (range (- spine-row k) (+ spine-row k 1)))))
                (dot acc r c color))))
           ((> cc cmax)
            (let ((inner (- cc 2)))
              (for*/fold ((acc out))
                         ((c (range inner (+ cc 1)))
                          (r (let ((k (- c inner)))
                               (range (- spine-row k) (+ spine-row k 1)))))
                (dot acc r c color))))
           (else out))))
     (define (ray-paint out r c dr dc color)
       (let loop ((acc out) (rr (+ r dr)) (cc (+ c dc)))
         (if (in-bounds? rr cc h w)
             (loop (set-cell acc rr cc color) (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc))
             acc)))
     (define r-edge  ;; last 4-way row: first v-domino's bottom (else spine end)
       (let ((vd (filter (lambda (d) (eq? (first d) 'v)) dominoes)))
         (if (empty? vd) rmax (fourth (first vd)))))
     (define c-edge  ;; last 4-way col: first h-domino's left (else spine end)
       (let ((hd (filter (lambda (d) (eq? (first d) 'h)) dominoes)))
         (if (empty? hd) cmax (fourth (first hd)))))
     (define (spray out s)
       (let* ((r (first s)) (c (second s)) (color (third s))
              (dirs (if (if spine-vertical? (<= r r-edge) (<= c c-edge))
                        diagonal-deltas
                        (if spine-vertical?
                            (list (list 1 -1) (list 1 1))
                            (list (list -1 1) (list 1 1))))))
         (foldl (lambda (d acc)
                  (ray-paint acc r c (first d) (second d) color))
                (dot out r c color)
                dirs)))
     (foldl (lambda (s acc) (spray acc s))
            (foldl (lambda (d acc)
                     (if (eq? (first d) 'h) (wedge-h acc d) (wedge-v acc d)))
                   (empty-grid h w 0)
                   dominoes)
            (reverse (sort-by singles (if spine-vertical? first second)))))))
